subject: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@alphasupply.com>
Cc: Chris Ward <chris@brokerfirm.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're close to issuing the PO but Procurement needs a few items to clear final activation. Chris, copying your broker so we can get this squared away quickly.

Summary of what's missing from the COI we received:
- Additional Insured: Redwood Inference (and its affiliates) must be listed as Additional Insured on the General Liability.
- Waiver of subrogation: need endorsement on the policy or a written waiver for GL/Workers' Comp where applicable.
- Policy effective dates: certificate currently shows a 30-day gap in April; please confirm continuous coverage through the contract term.
- Claims history: we only need a high-level 3-year losses summary (broker-stamped is fine).
- W-9: needed for AP routing.

If you can provide the endorsement (endorsement form or revised COI) and W-9 by end of Thursday 3/16 we'll issue a conditional PO (PO #RD-44321-CP) that allows work to start. If the endorsement is delayed we can still issue a PO with a 30-day conditional acceptance but finance will withhold first payment until documents are accepted.

I've attached a short template of the endorsement language our legal team prefers — feel free to have your broker populate it and return.

Attachments: Endorsement_Request_Template.docx

Next steps:
1) Laura / Broker provide endorsement(s) + updated COI + W-9
2) Procurement verifies and issues conditional PO
3) Finance completes AP setup on receipt of final docs

Thanks — let me know if you'd like to schedule a 15-min call later today.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura@alphasupply.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Ward <chris@brokerfirm.com>, procurement@alphasupply.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.

Monica —

Thanks for the note and clear list. We pushed this to our broker this morning. Quick answers:
- We can provide Additional Insured endorsement naming Redwood Inference.
- Waiver of subrogation: our current carrier is willing to provide these endorsements for GL and WC, but they need the exact wording you want.
- The COI gap you flagged is a clerical error on the certificate export — continuous coverage is in place.

I've attached what we currently have: COI_AlphaSupply_Initial.pdf and W9_AlphaSupply.pdf. Chris — can you confirm if you can issue the exact Additional Insured endorsement language and the waiver? If there's any premium or timing issue, flag it here and we'll coordinate.

Laura
VP, Operations
Alpha Supply Co.

Attachments: COI_AlphaSupply_Initial.pdf, W9_AlphaSupply.pdf

From: Chris Ward <chris@brokerfirm.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura@alphasupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.

Hi team —

Quick update from the broker side:
- I can provide a CG 20 10 (Additional Insured — blanket) or draft an owner/lessee endorsement that names Redwood Inference exactly as requested.
- Waiver of subrogation: carrier will issue an endorsement for GL and WC where Waiver is allowed; I'll confirm WC carrier wording separately.
- Claims history: attached a carrier-stamped summary for the last 3 years (redacted where required).

Timing: We can have the endorsement and corrected COI back to you by EOD Friday 3/16. There is no premium change for the requested endorsements.

Attachments: Claims_Summary_Alpha_3yrs.pdf

Chris Ward
Senior Account Exec, BrokerFirm
chris@brokerfirm.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Chris Ward <chris@brokerfirm.com>, Laura Chen <laura@alphasupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Finance <ap@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.

Thanks Chris — that's great news. Two quick clarifications before we accept the endorsement:
1) Insured name: please list "Redwood Inference, Inc.; and its subsidiaries, affiliates, and parent companies" as Additional Insured on the endorsement (exact phrase preferred).
2) Primary and non-contributory: endorsement should state that coverage is primary and non-contributory with respect to Redwood's claims.

Finance: we're prepared to issue the conditional PO RD-44321-CP once we have the signed endorsement and corrected COI. The conditional PO will allow Alpha Supply to begin work but first invoice will be held until final documents are confirmed. Please confirm if net-30 terms apply after that hold.

Marissa / Karthik — if Legal needs to review endorsement language I can route the broker's draft into Legal.

Monica

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Chris Ward <chris@brokerfirm.com>, Laura Chen <laura@alphasupply.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, AP <ap@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: insurance gaps & conditional PO for Alpha Supply Co.

Hi all —

Legal reviewed the requested wording and the phrasing Monica proposed is acceptable. A couple of small asks for the endorsement document:
- Please include Redwood's full legal entity: "Redwood Inference, Inc." and list the Redwood corporate address on the endorsement to match our records.
- If the endorsement references "affiliates", please ensure it's limited to "affiliates and subsidiaries" (no open-ended language).

Chris — once you send the final endorsement PDF and updated COI, Procurement can flip RD-44321-CP to Active and AP will release the first payment per the invoice terms.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marissa Cole
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
